entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Neeraj Singh Chouhan - Advocate for the appellant.
Shri S.K. Kashyap - Government Advocate for respondent/
1. Heard on admission.
2. Appeal is admitted for hearing.
3. Appellant has filed I.A. No.23297/2022 an application under Section 389(1) of Code of Criminal Procedure for suspension of jail sentence.

4. Appellant has been convicted under Sections 376(2)(n), 363, 366, 376(1) of the IPC and sentenced to undergo R.I. for ten years, five years, seven years and ten years with fine of Rs.5000/-, Rs.1000/-,
Rs.1000/-, Rs.5000/- respectively, with default stipulations.
5. It is submitted by learned counsel for the appellant that prosecution has failed to prove in accordance with law that prosecutrix is below 18 years of age.
On what basis date of birth of prosecutrix, in admission register is mentioned, is not clear.
PW-8 has stated that no documents regarding date of birth of prosecutrix were given to him for making entries in admission register.
Prosecutrix was consenting party.
There is no likelihood of hearing of appeal in near future.
Trial Court has committed an error in convicting the appellant.

6. Learned Government Advocate opposed the application for suspension of sentence and submitted that prosecution has successfully proved that prosecutrix is below 18 years of age on basis of admission register.

7. Heard the counsel for the parties.
8.
Considering the aforesaid, I.A. No.23297/2022 for suspension of sentence is allowed.
